name: Prime-weighted exponential sum
ant_standard_definition: Prime-weighted exponential sum with von Mangoldt weight.
ant_to_pvg_map: Faithfully reindex by decoded valuation vectors while preserving coefficients and additive phase.
pvg_geometric_object: Weighted decoded PVG point cloud with additive phase.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Decode each valuation vector and reconstruct the original finite sum.

name: Vaughan identity interface
statement: Decomposes Lambda-weighted sums into Type I, Type II, and short or trivial pieces after choosing cutoffs U,V.
ant_standard_definition: Parameterized Vaughan decomposition of von Mangoldt weighted sums.
ant_to_pvg_map: Translate multiplicative factor pairs into valuation-vector splits after fixing U and V.
pvg_geometric_object: Weighted valuation-vector split sums with declared cutoff metadata.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Decode split vectors to factor pairs and reconstruct each Vaughan component.
kernel_or_information_loss: Cancellation estimates and optimal cutoff choice remain external.
claim_ceiling: No cancellation follows from the decomposition alone.

name: Valuation-factor splitting
statement: Products mn correspond to nu(mn)=nu(m)+nu(n), so bilinear pieces become sums over valuation-vector splits.
ant_standard_definition: Multiplicative factor splitting inside a bilinear sum.
ant_to_pvg_map: Map each factor pair to the exact vector identity nu(mn)=nu(m)+nu(n).
pvg_geometric_object: Pairs of valuation vectors with fixed vector sum.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Decode each vector pair to the original integer factor pair.
kernel_or_information_loss: No arithmetic loss; analytic cancellation is not created.
claim_ceiling: Exact factor geometry does not imply analytic cancellation.

name: Type I estimate certificate
statement: Requires explicit coefficient bounds, variable ranges, alpha domain, uniformity, and a quantitative saving over the trivial bound.
ant_standard_definition: Uniform Type I estimate with explicit ranges and saving.
ant_to_pvg_map: Attach the analytic certificate to the translated Type I component.
pvg_geometric_object: Translated Type I vector-split sum plus external analytic metadata.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Decode to the original Type I sum and recover attached hypotheses.
kernel_or_information_loss: Uniform saving is not encoded by valuation geometry.
claim_ceiling: Finite examples do not establish a uniform Type I estimate.

name: Type II estimate certificate
statement: Requires a bilinear cancellation bound uniform in both factor ranges and in alpha over the stated arc domain.
ant_standard_definition: Uniform bilinear Type II estimate over declared ranges and arc domain.
ant_to_pvg_map: Attach the analytic certificate to the translated bilinear vector-split sum.
pvg_geometric_object: Translated Type II vector-pair sum plus external uniformity metadata.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Decode to the original bilinear sum and recover attached hypotheses.
kernel_or_information_loss: Bilinear cancellation and uniformity remain external.
claim_ceiling: A bilinear decomposition is not a Type II theorem.

name: Minor-arc transfer
statement: Uniform Type I and Type II estimates plus control of remaining terms can imply a minor-arc bound for S(alpha;N).
ant_standard_definition: Conditional transfer from complete Vaughan-component estimates to a uniform minor-arc bound.
ant_to_pvg_map: Represent each component geometrically while retaining every analytic hypothesis externally.
pvg_geometric_object: Family of translated Vaughan components indexed over the minor-arc domain.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Decode components and reconstruct the original minor-arc estimate problem.
kernel_or_information_loss: The saving and uniformity are not supplied by the translation.
claim_ceiling: All hypotheses and ranges must be supplied.

name: Major-arc transfer
statement: Prime distribution in residue classes and local Fourier analysis support approximation of S(a/q+beta;N) on major arcs.
ant_standard_definition: Conditional major-arc approximation using residue-class distribution and local Fourier factors.
ant_to_pvg_map: Translate residue channels and local phases while preserving analytic inputs as external certificates.
pvg_geometric_object: Residue-channel and phase observables on decoded PVG points.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Decode to the original major-arc exponential sum and local factors.
kernel_or_information_loss: Asymptotic error control and singular-series analysis remain external.
claim_ceiling: No singular-series asymptotic without a complete analytic certificate.

name: Major/minor arc separation
statement: Major-arc approximation and minor-arc domination are independent certificate obligations.
ant_standard_definition: Certificate-separation rule for the two circle-method regions.
ant_to_pvg_map: Apply the same separation to translated Addition-Fiber Fourier sums.
pvg_geometric_object: Two separately certified translated arc regions.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Decode each region to its original ANT obligation.
claim_ceiling: Neither side may be inferred from the other.

name: PVG analytic-loss ledger
statement: PVG preserves factor splits, weights, decoded integers, and additive phases, but not oscillatory estimates, arc uniformity, or asymptotic constants.
ant_standard_definition: Information-loss ledger for translating prime-weighted exponential sums.
ant_to_pvg_map: Preserve finite arithmetic data and mark analytic inputs as external.
pvg_geometric_object: Translated weighted vector-split and phase data.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Decode the preserved finite data; external estimates must be reattached.
kernel_or_information_loss: Oscillatory savings, arc uniformity, and asymptotic constants are not encoded.
claim_ceiling: No analytic saving is created by reindexing.

name: Decomposition is not cancellation
statement: Reject Vaughan decomposition implies a nontrivial minor-arc estimate.
ant_standard_definition: Negative inference rule separating algebraic decomposition from analytic cancellation.

name: Finite grid is not continuous control
statement: Reject small values on a finite alpha grid imply a uniform bound on the full minor-arc set.
ant_standard_definition: Negative inference rule separating finite sampling from continuum uniformity.
ant_to_pvg_map: Apply unchanged to translated finite-grid experiments.
pvg_geometric_object: Finite alpha-grid sample of translated sums.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Decode to the original sampled sums.
kernel_or_information_loss: Continuum control is absent from finite samples.

name: No Goldbach transfer
statement: Reject prime-weighted exponential-sum identities or finite experiments imply binary Goldbach.
ant_standard_definition: Negative inference rule blocking transfer from identities or finite experiments to binary Goldbach.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Decode to the original finite evidence.
